definitions: The various techniques and conventions used in filmmaking to convey meaning, emotion, and narrative to an audience.
The visual and auditory grammar of cinema, encompassing elements like shot composition, editing, sound design, and mise-en-scène.
examples: The director's mastery of cinematic language was evident in every scene.
Understanding cinematic language helps viewers appreciate the artistry of a film.
Early filmmakers developed much of the cinematic language we use today.
